up: Return the first 1000 activity rows for the target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1293255 (15-hydroxyprostaglandin dehydrogenase [NAD(+)]), a human single-protein target. Include rows where the standard type is IC50, the standard relation is '=', and a pChEMBL value is present. Output the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_data AS (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293255') SELECT DISTINCT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_data td_filter ON ass.tid = td_filter.tid JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
